identity.name: inventory_session_identity
identity.interpretation: All booleans must be true; otherwise no business aggregate runs.

capabilities.name: relation_capabilities
capabilities.interpretation: Fixed table allowlist only. RLS,missing SELECT or missing relation means affected counts are UNOBSERVED; do not infer zeros.

queries.name: assets_by_role_and_processing_state
queries.interpretation: Canonical music_asset database rows only; __other__ counts unexpected code values without exporting them. No stored-object existence, MIME validation, rights or playability claim.

queries.name: release_totals
queries.interpretation: Publication pointer/timestamps are database facts,not discoverability or authorization.

queries.name: release_versions_by_state
queries.interpretation: Fixed lifecycle-code counts; published state alone is not an authorized delivery claim.

queries.name: processing_jobs_by_state
queries.interpretation: Status counts only; no job keys,worker IDs,error codes or failure summaries are selected.

queries.name: upload_sessions_by_state
queries.interpretation: Canonical upload statuses only; multipart/object/provider IDs and names never leave the host.

queries.name: ready_asset_reference_gaps
queries.interpretation: Database structural references and blank reference strings only. Zero may follow validated constraints; it does not establish stored-object existence or byte access.

queries.name: published_reference_gaps
queries.interpretation: DB predicates mirror relevant cover/master/stream checks in music validation SQL; not full publication validation,rights,visibility,storage delivery or current API eligibility.

queries.name: structural_orphan_references
queries.interpretation: Named structural/reference counts only. Unreferenced draft recordings/assets can be legitimate; no deletion,automatic repair,duplicate-content or storage-orphan claim.

queries.name: legacy_artist_release_reference_totals
queries.interpretation: Only legacy reference presence; provider pages are not automatically native audio,available,owned or authorized. Other uploads/social/podcasts/storage are outside this collector.
